mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.name AS studentName, u.login_id AS studentLoginId, d.name AS departmentName, r.request_type, r.reason, r.target_year, r.target_semester, r.return_year, r.return_semester, r.status, r.reject_reason, r.created_at, r.attachment_file_path AS attachmentFilePath FROM academic_requests r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN students s ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.name AS studentName, u.login_id AS studentLoginId, d.name AS departmentName, r.request_type, r.reason, r.target_year, r.target_semester, r.return_year, r.return_semester, r.status, r.reject_reason, r.created_at, r.attachment_file_path AS attachmentFilePath FROM academic_requests r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN students s ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE academic_requests SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
